comment: Mini knowledge base embedded into the triage workflow to ground suggested responses (mini-RAG). Retrieval is deterministic keyword/phrase scoring; only entries scoring at or above the threshold can ground a suggested response. Guidance text is informational only and never promises refunds, compensation, or account actions.

entries.title: Shipping delays and tracking
entries.guidance: Per our shipping policy, domestic orders usually arrive in 3-5 business days and international orders in 7-14 days. Once an order leaves the warehouse, live tracking appears on the order page.

entries.title: Damaged or defective items
entries.guidance: Damaged-in-transit items are handled by the support team: report the item and keep the packaging, and the standard process is to inspect the report and prepare a replacement or remedy per the returns policy.

entries.title: Billing and duplicate charges
entries.guidance: Duplicate charges are reviewed by the billing team. Statements and receipts are available from the billing page, and every payment record has a transaction ID that the team can trace.

entries.title: App crashes and technical issues
entries.guidance: Known technical issues are tracked by the engineering team. A fresh app install usually resolves client-side problems, and crash reports attached to support tickets shorten diagnosis.

entries.title: Support availability and response times
entries.guidance: Standard support response time is within one business day, and urgent channels run during business hours. Ticket volume spikes can temporarily increase wait times.

entries.title: Account and sign-in access
entries.guidance: Password resets and account recovery are self-service from the sign-in page. Account locks clear automatically after the cool-down window passes.

entries.title: Data privacy and deletion requests
entries.guidance: Data-deletion and opt-out requests are routed to the privacy team, which verifies ownership before erasing personal data in line with the published retention schedule.

entries.title: Compliments and positive feedback
entries.guidance: Positive feedback is shared weekly with the product and support teams, and recurring praise themes are tracked as signals for what to keep doing.

entries.title: Feature requests and suggestions
entries.guidance: Feature suggestions are logged for the product team and tagged by theme; popular recurring themes are surfaced on the public roadmap review.

entries.title: Central intake and unit resolution (holding-company pattern)
entries.guidance: Feedback entered without a specific unit stays in the central queue; naming a unit routes visibility to that unit while the group-level audit trail stays unified.
